HIS 140 Syllabus: Grading

Essays are worth 50 percent of the final grade in HIS 140.

Each essay is marked against the rubric posted on the course page.

Late essays lose 5 percent per day.

HIS 140 Syllabus: Essays

Each HIS 140 essay must be between 2,000 and 2,500 words.

HIS 140 essays must cite at least four primary sources.

Primary sources are documents written at the time, such as letters, ledgers and charters.

HIS 140 Syllabus: Schedule

The course moves from the founding of the League to its decline, one century every two weeks.

HIS 140 meets on Mondays in the Pell Building, room 3.

The HIS 140 midterm is held in week 6.

HIS 140 Syllabus: Office hours and appeals

Professor Quist holds office hours on Wednesday afternoons.

Office hours are first come, first served. Bring a draft if you want feedback on an essay.

Questions about grades must be raised within one week of marks being returned.
